title.narrative: Inceasing ReSilience of COMMunities for risk prevention and management - RESCOMM

description.narrative: The project is to contribute to the improvement of risk prevention and management and climate changes mitigation and adaptation in the cross border area of Montenegro and Bosnia and Herzegovina. In this effort, the project will strengthen prevention, preparedness and response capacities of emergency services to deal with climate change disasters.
